acceptedFreshGenerations.prompt: Create ONE original isolated pixel-art game sprite with a genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha background. Output a transparent PNG cutout, all empty space alpha zero. No checkerboard pattern, no paper, no solid backdrop, no floor or shadow. Strict straight-down top view, nose points UP. Polished hard-edged 16-bit pixel art, large deliberate pixel clusters, about48logicalpixels enlarged, limitedpalette, no photo-texture. One centered complete Ukrainian FPV drone BODY, four motor hubs, a small camera at the top, compact battery, a small blue-over-yellow flag patch, thin carbonframe, short rearantenna. No propeller blades at all; those are animated separately in the application. No weapons, no text, no Z or other military insignia, no glow. Empty negative spaces INSIDE the frame must also be truly transparent. Keep a useful transparent margin around the entire form. The variant is a compact protected FPV with four slender dark charcoal circular propeller guards, one around each motor at the four corners. Rings are thin and separated; the space between each hub and ring remains empty/transparent except for a single thin support. Four motor centers form a square. The central body is small and narrow, slate-blue upper strapping with olive battery and warm-gray edge pixels. The overall design reads as a light real FPV frame, not a bulky rounded toy. Use simple readable shapes and a few warm ivory highlight pixels. The guards distinguish this cosmetic variant from an open X-frame.
